description: Defines abstract and concrete classes for storing and managing modules in PyTorch's neural network framework, including placeholder and holder classes for modules with support for forwarding, copying, and cloning.

classes.name: AnyModulePlaceholder
classes.description: Abstract base class for placeholders of modules stored in AnyModule, providing virtual methods for forwarding, copying, and cloning modules.

classes.name: AnyModuleHolder
classes.description: Template class that holds a concrete module instance, forwarding calls and managing default arguments, cloning, and pointer retrieval.

methods.name: forward
methods.description: Invokes the forward() method of the stored module with provided arguments.

methods.name: ptr
methods.description: Returns a shared pointer to the stored module.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of the placeholder.

methods.name: clone_module
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the module, optionally on a specified device.
